'''Chirrion Base''' was a [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] base of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="RAS2" /> located in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Chirrion system/Legends|Chirrion system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Rolion sector/Legends|Rolion sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="RAS2" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="0 ABY">Per [[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]], [[Herrit]]'s attempt to discover the target of the upcoming [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Raid on Fara's Belt|attack]] took place between the entering of [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing starfighters]] in Alliance service and the [[Evacuation of Yavin|end]] of [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna's]] service with the Alliance, events that are dated to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' and ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', respectively.</ref> in an effort to find out which of the Empire's 752 bases in the Rolion [[Sector/Legends|sector]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was planning to [[Raid on Fara's Belt|attack]], [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Herrit]] of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] contacted all of those installations and instructed each of them to report a different common systems malfunction&mdash;in the case of Chirrion Base, "environmental problems"&mdash;to the central Imperial headquarters. Imperial Intelligence subsequently identified the Alliance's target base when it intercepted a Rebel transmission mentioning the malfunction reported by the [[Unidentified Imperial communications station|Imperial communications station]] in [[Fara's Belt]].<ref name="RAS2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chirrion Base was first mentioned in [[Paul Murphy]]'s [[1990]] ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', which was published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="RAS">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>
